blocks.html: Holiday Fair at the Mini Christmas Village in Robinsons Galleria

The Christmas countdown is ticking by fast and at around this time of the year, you’ll find yourself surrounded by Christmas decorations everywhere you go. But is your home spruced and ready for the Holidays? Don’t miss out the elegant and classic offerings of Handyman’s Holiday Fair 2015, currently ongoing at the Activity Area of Robinsons Galleria.

Check out Ginger Bread Houses in the Activity area where the decors and other home trimmings are neatly displayed as you enjoy discounts of up to 50% on these items that will surely complete your Christmas Holiday Décor shopping list while your kids have fun as they play at the Christmas villages made just for the occasion. A dancing and singing Santa invites you to revel at the giant candy canes, gingerbread houses and lush Christmas trees—perfect backdrops to take photos with the whole family. And to make your Christmas shopping truly merry and bright, watch out for other special events lined up. Sign your kids up for Santa’s Christmas workshop filled with fun games and activities on November 14 from 12nn to 5pm and be enchanted by the singing voices of the De La Salle University’s Corro Amino during the Grand Chorale at 6pm of the same day.
So plan ahead and make your way down the Activity Area at Level 1, Robinsons Galleroa. Exhibit lasts until November 25.
